name: caravan
description: Fan recreation of the Fallout: New Vegas Caravan card game, playable online in the browser.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@caravan/server & npm run dev --workspace=@caravan/client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@caravan/client && npm run build --workspace=@caravan/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/client
